scenarios.task: Rough in EMT conduit and branch circuits for a new wet-lab bench grid in a live research building.
hazards: Live circuits in adjacent panels (NFPA 70E arc flash)
Energized lab equipment that cannot be shut down
Overhead ceiling work near sprinkler lines
Silica dust from concrete core drilling
steps: Verify energized work permit and lockout/tagout status with lab staff
Confirm lab shutdown window with facility coordinator before core drilling
Install EMT runs and boxes per blueprint above ceiling grid
Pull conductors and megger-test before terminations
Label all circuits and update as-built drawings
Restore panels under LOTO removal procedure with qualified person

rubric.pass_if: Performs lockout/tagout and requests an energized work permit before touching live equipment
Confirms shutdown window with lab staff before dust-generating drilling
Conduit runs are supported per NEC 358 and fully labeled at completion

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and scans above-ceiling route for existing conduit before the apprentice drills.

scenarios.task: Replace a section of corroded acid-waste drainage piping serving lab sinks without interrupting active fume hoods.
hazards: Chemical residue in existing pipe (corrosives, unknown pH)
Confined crawlspace access under lab floor
Fumes when cutting existing drain line
Sharp pipe edges
ppe: Half-mask respirator with organic vapor/acid gas cartridges
steps: Obtain lab shutdown and chemical line clearance
Drain and flush line with neutralizing solution per site SOP
Cut out corroded section using spill containment tray
Install new polypropylene pipe with fusion joints
Pressure and leak test before returning to service
Complete chemical disposal manifest for removed piping

rubric.pass_if: Flushes and neutralizes line before cutting and uses containment
Verifies lab clearance and that fume hoods remain operational throughout
Disposes of pipe and flush waste through proper hazardous waste manifest

scenarios.task: Rig and set a replacement air-handling unit on the rooftop mechanical deck above the lakefront lab wing.
hazards: Crane load swing near glass curtain wall
Fall exposure within 6 feet of unprotected roof edge
Overhead load over workers below
Wind gusts off Lake Union
steps: Attend lift plan briefing and confirm signal person assignment
Inspect slings, shackles and spreader bars and remove damaged gear
Establish and enforce exclusion zone below lift path
Tie off to approved anchor points before approaching edge
Guide unit onto curbs with tag lines, hands clear of pinch points
Land, secure and sign off the rigging inspection sheet

rubric.pass_if: Completes pre-lift gear inspection and rejects any damaged component
Maintains 100% tie-off within 6 feet of the roof edge
Uses standard hand signals and confirms exclusion zone before load leaves ground

scenarios.robot_role: Walks the lift path and confirms the roof exclusion zone is clear before the crane picks.

scenarios.task: Perform laser alignment on a chilled-water pump motor in the central utility plant under a group lockout.
hazards: Stored hydraulic/thermal energy in chilled water loop
Rotating equipment restart
Confined noise in pump room
Heavy motor handling
steps: Apply personal lock and tag to all energy isolation points
Verify zero-energy state by attempt-start and bleed loop pressure
Remove coupling guard and mount laser alignment fixtures
Shim motor to within tolerance on alignment readout
Torque hold-down bolts and reinstall guards
Remove locks per group LOTO procedure and document

rubric.pass_if: Applies personal LOTO lock and verifies zero energy with attempt-start
Final alignment within specified tolerance before guard reinstall
Coupling guards fully reinstalled before lock removal

scenarios.robot_role: Holds the dial indicator and logs alignment readings while the apprentice shims.

scenarios.task: Fabricate and install a stainless duct transition for a new fume hood exhaust riser tie-in.
hazards: Tin cuts and sharp sheet metal edges
Work at height on rolling scaffold
Existing exhaust riser with chemical-laden air
Riveting/breaker press pinch points
ppe: Harness if using rolling scaffold above 6 ft
steps: Field measure existing riser tie-in location
Fabricate transition in shop with guards on brake and shear
Cap or isolate existing riser before cutting in
Set scaffold, lock casters and tie off as required
Install transition with gaskets and seal all joints leak-tight
Smoke-test joints for negative-pressure integrity

rubric.pass_if: Uses guards and push sticks on shear/brake and gloves for handling sheet metal
Verifies riser isolation/cap before cutting into existing duct
Smoke test confirms all joints leak-free

scenarios.task: Decontaminate and clear a legacy cold-room interior before renovation of an observatory meeting space on the converted lab floor.
hazards: Mold and bioresidue from years of condensation
Confined space entry in cold room
Chemical decontaminants (bleach/sporicide)
Poor lighting and limited egress
steps: Obtain confined space permit and set up attendant and log
Test atmosphere for oxygen, CO and LEL before entry
Set decon zones: clean, warm, hot
Apply sporicide, dwell per label, then wet-remove residue
Bag and stage waste per biohazard profile
Final air/visual clearance and permit closeout

rubric.pass_if: Completes permit, atmosphere testing and attendant logging before entry
Follows label dwell times and maintains zone separation
Bags, labels and stages all residue as biohazard waste

scenarios.robot_role: Tows waste totes out of the hot zone and carries a gas monitor so attendant reads live atmospheres.

scenarios.task: Set pedestrian protection, erosion controls and material staging at the shoreline-side excavation for a new Charter Hall lobby.
hazards: Open excavation near public walkway on Lake Union trail
Water intrusion/soft ground near shoreline
Struck-by from equipment traffic
Weather exposure
steps: Install chain-link pedestrian barricade along trail detour
Lay silt fence and inlet protection between trench and lake
Set gravel staging pad and equipment exclusion markers
Verify trench access ladder placement each shift
Check weather forecast and pump readiness for rain events
Participate in daily toolbox talk and sign crew sheet

rubric.pass_if: Barricade fully separates trail users from excavation and equipment
Silt fence installed between disturbance and shoreline before rain risk
Verifies ladder access and attends toolbox talk each shift
